title: Staging deploys go through deploy/queue.yaml; deploy.sh is silently reverted
prompt: The change in config/staging.yaml needs to reach staging -- get it deployed.
checks: AllOf(name='queued_not_direct_deploy_leg2', of=(FileMatchCountAtLeast(name='queue_gained_staging_entry', path='deploy/queue.yaml', pattern='target:\\s*staging', minimum=2), CommandRan(name='no_direct_deploy_script', pattern='(\\./)?deploy\\.sh\\b', want=False), FileUnchanged(name='deploy_state_untouched', path='.deploy-state')))
